summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a proposed offering of CAD $750 million principal amount of Series 2026-1 Subordinated Unsecured 4.21% Fixed/Floating Debentures due 2038. The offering is expected to close on June 19, 2026, with net proceeds used for general corporate purposes including investments in subsidiaries, repayment of indebtedness, and other strategic investments. CIBC Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets and TD Securities act as co-lead agents on a reasonable best efforts agency basis. The debentures are expected to qualify as Tier 2 capital and are not registered for sale in the United States. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
